research_question: Can a genuinely nonparametric historical-event reaction model, with no fitted outcome coefficients, rank 08:58:59-known TDnet events well enough to clear an independent production-readiness gate?

authority.purpose: retrospective zero-base hypothesis falsification and possible forward-shadow qualification
authority.reason: The panel is retrospective and the HTML caches lack archive observation timestamps. Even a full statistical pass can only qualify a frozen candidate for a new prospective shadow.

point_in_time_contract.disclosure_assignment: Assign to the first panel session whose 08:58:59 cutoff is at or after published_at.
point_in_time_contract.overnight_rule: Exclude a prior-session disclosure published before that session's market close; accept same-session premarket, prior-session post-close, and intervening non-session disclosures.
point_in_time_contract.source_completeness: Every calendar-date cache page from the prior panel session through the target session inclusive must exist. Missing-source sessions are excluded and never treated as no-event.
point_in_time_contract.training_time_rule: For every calendar-month fold, every analog outcome and every comparator training row must have date strictly earlier than the first scored session in that month.
point_in_time_contract.feature_rule: Only title text, publication metadata known by cutoff, code identity, event-family flags parsed from title, and marketwide bundle counts known by cutoff may enter analog retrieval. Target-session open, high, low, close, volume, return, and label are prohibited.

sample_and_folds.score_sessions: All strict-source-complete panel sessions in the score window.
sample_and_folds.training: All strict-source-complete event-code bundles strictly before the score month, inner-joined to price_training_eligible rows with observed open-to-close outcomes.
sample_and_folds.score: Event-code bundles on score sessions inner-joined to price_eligible panel rows.
sample_and_folds.walk_forward: Calendar-month expanding; refit the text vocabulary and rebuild the analog library once per scored month.

outcome_and_portfolio.target: same-session open-to-close gross return in percentage points
outcome_and_portfolio.training_target_clipping: Within each fold, clip observed training outcomes to its 1st and 99th percentiles, additionally bounded to [-10, 10].
outcome_and_portfolio.selection: Highest analog scores among eligible event bundles; deterministic code-ascending tie break.
outcome_and_portfolio.slot_weighting: Equal sleeves. A missing or abstained slot remains cash and pays no cost.
outcome_and_portfolio.primary_metric: scheduled-session arithmetic mean after 40 bp round-trip cost

representation.fit_scope: strictly prior training bundles in each monthly fold

shared_retrieval_contract.neighbor_tie_break: higher cosine similarity, then earlier date, then code ascending, then stable row order
shared_retrieval_contract.base_similarity_weight: cosine_similarity squared; if the selected support has zero total weight, use equal weights

L4_price_control.model: daily-percentile Ridge(alpha=1) on the frozen v10 L4 price feature set
L4_price_control.purpose: deployed-style price-only control, evaluated on exactly the same score sessions

T02_char_value_event_only.model: char TF-IDF Ridge(alpha=20) on clipped value target
T02_char_value_event_only.purpose: strong known v10 event-title comparator, reproduced in the same folds and portfolio engine

registered_hypotheses.score: similarity-squared weighted mean clipped return across the common 31 neighbors
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Local title geometry contains repeatable reactions that a nonparametric conditional mean can recover without fitted coefficients.

registered_hypotheses.analog_pool: all prior bundles except the scored issuer
registered_hypotheses.score: similarity-squared weighted mean clipped return across the common 31 neighbors
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Transferable event semantics, not issuer autocorrelation, drives the reaction.

registered_hypotheses.score: weighted mean with cosine-squared weight multiplied by an exponential 126-session half-life
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: The reaction map drifts, so recent analogs should dominate without estimating model coefficients.

registered_hypotheses.analog_pool: prior bundles from other issuers, retaining only the highest-similarity bundle per historical issuer before taking the common 31 neighbors
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Issuer clusters can create false confidence; one analog per other issuer estimates a genuinely cross-code reaction.

registered_hypotheses.score: similarity-weighted empirical 35th percentile of clipped return across the common 31 neighbors
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: execute only bundles whose lower-bound score exceeds the 40 bp primary cost; rejected or missing slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: A positive local lower-tail outcome is safer than a high local mean for sparse top-of-list trading.

registered_hypotheses.score: weighted P(return > 1.0%) minus 1.5 times weighted P(return < -1.0%) over the common 31 neighbors
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: execute only positive-utility bundles; rejected or missing slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating upside and downside reaction frequency is more useful than estimating a conditional mean.

registered_hypotheses.analog_pool: all prior bundles represented by fixed parsed title-family flags rather than TF-IDF proximity
registered_hypotheses.score: Jaccard-similarity weighted mean clipped return over all prototypes with positive family overlap; fall back to the prior global event mean only when no overlap exists
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coarse corporate-action family prototypes generalize better than lexical nearest neighbors.

registered_hypotheses.analog_pool: only prior bundles of the scored issuer
registered_hypotheses.score: similarity-squared weighted mean clipped return over up to the common 31 available issuer events
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: no global fallback; issuers without prior events abstain and slots remain cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Issuer-specific disclosure style and investor base dominate cross-issuer semantic transfer.

registered_hypotheses.score: weighted median clipped return multiplied by the absolute weighted positive-minus-negative reaction share
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: A robust local center discounted by sign disagreement avoids mean estimates driven by a few extreme analogs.

registered_hypotheses.analog_pool: other-issuer prior bundles having the maximum available Jaccard event-family overlap with the score bundle, then the common 31 highest cosine similarities
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: rank all score bundles; absent slots are cash
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Restricting lexical analogs to the closest structural event family prevents semantically adjacent but economically different titles from mixing.

point_metrics: gross and net mean, median, win rate at 20/40/60 bp
filled and scheduled slots, cash rate, unique codes
stability: net20 after removing the best 20 scheduled sessions
net20 after replacing the top 10 positive-contribution codes with cash

multiplicity.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples within month, block length 5 sessions, seed 20260723
multiplicity.primary_comparator: the stronger observed top1 net40 comparator among L4_price_control and T02_char_value_event_only
multiplicity.adjustment: single-step familywise max-centered-mean reality check and 90% simultaneous lower bound for candidate uplift

required_integrity_checks: all input hashes exactly match the protocol
strictly prior training in every fold
source-missing sessions never encoded as no-event
target-session outcome mutation leaves every score, selection key, and fill decision unchanged
saved pick outcomes reproduce every reported gross/net P&L metric exactly
deterministic rerun produces byte-identical picks and candidate metrics

independent_gate.candidate_selection: Select the largest top1 net40 mean among candidates passing every retrospective statistical and robustness requirement. No fallback winner.
retrospective_requirements: top1 net40 uplift versus both L4_price_control and T02_char_value_event_only > 0
top1 90% familywise simultaneous lower bound for uplift versus the stronger comparator > 0
top1 net20 after top-10 positive-contribution codes are replaced by cash > 0
top1 net40 mean > 0 in discovery, confirmation_a, and confirmation_b
top1 net40 mean > 0 in at least 4 of 5 scored months
top1 has a filled slot on at least 80% of scheduled score sessions
all integrity, mutation, deterministic-reproduction, and P&L audits pass
production_requirements: one candidate passes every retrospective requirement without post-registration mutation
historical source observation provenance is independently proven or rebuilt from timestamped archives
the frozen candidate then passes at least 120 new strict-source-complete prospective sessions beginning after registration
prospective top1 net40 mean > 0 with a one-sided 95% moving-block lower confidence bound > 0
prospective top1 net20 remains > 0 after best-20-session removal and top-10-code cash replacement
no production or order-routing change occurs before an explicit human approval
independent_gate.decision_this_run: retrospective run can only reject or retain for a new forward shadow
